summary: Candidate is a distinct Spring Boot 3.0 actuator endpoint exposure configuration skill with no semantic overlap to existing skills. Existing skills cover Next.js font optimization and Flink streaming setup—different domains entirely. Peer candidates (Batch Job Execution, Session Store Auto-Configuration, Jakarta EE Migration) are all Spring Boot 3.0 migration tasks but address different configuration concerns (batch job naming, session store selection, package namespace migration). This skill is semantically unique: it configures JMX and HTTP actuator endpoint exposure via management.endpoints properties, a capability not present in the registry.
